messages:
IncidentBot: PAGER (P1) — multi-region latency spike detected for /v1/embeddings (routing latency > 2s across us-east & eu-west). Impacting ~12 customers, error rate rising. Incident tracker: https://tracker.redwood.ai/INC-20260315-17 — paging primary oncall.
Alex H: I'm the current primary but mid-transit, phone on silent for the next ~20m. If this requires hands-on, I can't reliably join voice. :disappointed:
Maria G: I'm listed as secondary. Can take primary now — standing by. Will update handoff when OpsBot confirms.
Samir K: Quick ask — do we have a hotfix runbook for embedding timeouts? I can start the mitigation steps (scale & route) if Maria wants me as secondary.
Jess P: Runbook link: runbook://latency-embeddings-v1 — short checklist: scale pool, check KV-cache hit rates, fallback model, analyze tail latencies. Also note customer-facing template in tracker.
Maria G: Ok grabbing runbook. Alex, if you can't reach, I'll take primary. @OpsBot can you perform the formal handoff so paging is routed to me?
OpsBot: Received handoff request. To confirm, run the following slash command in this channel to perform automated oncall handoff:
```
/ops handoff --from "Alex H" --to "Maria G" --until "2026-03-15T08:00:00Z" --note "in-transit, phone on silent"
```
Reply `confirm` to proceed.
Alex H: confirm — handed off. Maria, I've forwarded brief notes into the tracker (small list of recent deploys + last model kernel swap).
Maria G: Confirmed. I'm primary now. Samir you're secondary. I'll open a conference bridge if we need deeper troubleshooting. :phone:
Samir K: Starting mitigation: 1) scale embeddings pool +20% (burst nodes), 2) enable KV prefix caching override for top clients, 3) route low-latency traffic to `dedicated-emb-1` in us-east for customers on reserved capacity. Running step 1 now.
Jess P: If scaling doesn't bring tail down in 5m, fallback plan B is to roll traffic to quantized v1-q8 (compatible weights). Patch notes in tracker. Also consider temporarily increasing timeout from 1.5s -> 3s for UX-sensitive routes.
Maria G: Noted. Action items: Samir scaling now, Jess prepare quantized rollout, I will monitor logs & customer impact and keep tracker updated. Customer impact so far: 10–15% error rate spike for embeddings; top affected customers: AcmeCorp, SynapseAI, LumaSearch (contacting CSMs).
IncidentBot: Automated update — errors for embeddings increased from 0.8% -> 12.4% in last 3m. Avg p95 latency now 2.8s. Suggest immediate mitigation.
Samir K: Scale completed, nodes registered, load balancing rerouted. Initial telemetry: p95 down to 1.9s but error rate still ~8%. Running KV cache flush for cold misses on next step.
Maria G: I'm going to open a quick ad-hoc bridge — dial-in: meet.redwood.ai/bridge/5267893456 — anyone with bandwidth join. If no one can join, keep updates here.
Jess P: Preparing canary for v1-q8 -> will route 5% traffic to canary in eu-west. If canary looks good in 4m, we can ramp.
Alex H: FYI — I put last deploy hashes in the tracker under 'recent deploys' and noted a kernel patch rolled yesterday that could affect attention kernels; not sure relevant but flagging.
Samir K: KV cache flush done; minor improvement in errors (now ~6%). Continuing to watch.
Maria G: Good progress. I'm updating incident tracker with current mitigation steps and customer notifications. Can someone volunteer to draft the short customer note for impacted tenants? Need it in the tracker within 10m.
Jess P: I'll start the draft. Template: short summary, ETA to resolution (best-effort right now), mitigation performed, contact info for CSM/SE.
OpsBot: Handoff complete: primary -> Maria G (effective 2026-03-15T07:38Z). Pager routing updated.
Maria G: Thanks OpsBot. Final note for now: Maria primary, Samir secondary, Jess on rollback/canary, Alex reachable by DM (less reliable). If situation regresses, escalate to Eng-Platform and page SRE lead. I'll post another update in 10m or sooner. :white_check_mark:
